nodes.label: Delivery performance
nodes.description: How consistently a parcel reaches its destination by the promised time.

nodes.label: Dispatch operations
nodes.description: How parcels move from a sorting hub to a carrier.

nodes.label: On-time delivery
nodes.description: Share of completed parcels delivered by the promised time.

nodes.label: Handoff latency
nodes.description: Time between a parcel being ready and the carrier accepting it.

nodes.label: Promised window
nodes.description: The delivery deadline recorded when the parcel is accepted.

nodes.label: Dispatch delay
nodes.description: A handoff after the hub’s dispatch cutoff may reduce the time available for delivery.

nodes.label: Carrier capacity
nodes.description: The number of parcels a carrier can accept in a dispatch window.

nodes.label: Delivery policy
nodes.description: Defines the promised window and which deliveries count toward the metric.

nodes.label: Event dictionary
nodes.description: Defines timestamps recorded at the hub and at delivery.

nodes.label: Dispatch playbook
nodes.description: Documents dispatch cutoffs and how capacity is planned.
